description: This file contains functions and logic for diagnosing and repairing the state integrity of the OpenClaw application, including checks on session files, directories, permissions, and cloud-synced storage. It also provides user prompts for fixing issues.

classes.name: DoctorPrompterLike
classes.description: Interface for prompting user confirmation during state repair operations.

methods.name: countLabel
methods.description: Returns a string with the count and singular/plural label.

methods.name: formatFilePreview
methods.description: Creates a preview string of file paths, limited to a specified number.

methods.name: existsDir
methods.description: Checks if a directory exists and is a directory.

methods.name: existsFile
methods.description: Checks if a file exists and is a file.

methods.name: canWriteDir
methods.description: Checks if a directory is writable.

methods.name: ensureDir
methods.description: Creates a directory recursively, returning success status.

methods.name: dirPermissionHint
methods.description: Provides permission hints based on owner and group mismatch.

methods.name: addUserRwx
methods.description: Adds user read/write/execute permissions to a mode.

methods.name: countJsonlLines
methods.description: Counts lines in a JSONL file.

methods.name: findOtherStateDirs
methods.description: Finds other state directories on Linux or macOS roots.

methods.name: isPathUnderRoot
methods.description: Checks if a path is under a specified root.

methods.name: tryResolveRealPath
methods.description: Attempts to resolve the real path of a target.

methods.name: decodeMountInfoPath
methods.description: Decodes octal escape sequences in mount info paths.

methods.name: escapeControlCharsForTerminal
methods.description: Escapes control characters for terminal display.

methods.name: parseLinuxMountInfo
methods.description: Parses Linux mountinfo data into structured entries.

methods.name: isPathUnderRootWithPathOps
methods.description: Checks if a path is under a root using custom path operations.

methods.name: findLinuxMountInfoEntryForPath
methods.description: Finds the best matching Linux mount info entry for a path.

methods.name: isMmcDevicePath
methods.description: Checks if a device path is an MMC device.

methods.name: tryReadLinuxMountInfo
methods.description: Reads Linux mountinfo from /proc/self/mountinfo.

methods.name: detectLinuxSdBackedStateDir
methods.description: Detects if a state directory is on Linux SD/eMMC storage.

methods.name: formatLinuxSdBackedStateDirWarning
methods.description: Formats a warning message about SD/eMMC storage.

methods.name: detectMacCloudSyncedStateDir
methods.description: Detects if a state directory is on macOS cloud storage.

methods.name: isRecord
methods.description: Type guard for objects.

methods.name: isPairingPolicy
methods.description: Checks if a string indicates a pairing policy.

methods.name: hasPairingPolicy
methods.description: Recursively checks if a config object has a pairing policy.

methods.name: isSlashRoutingSessionKey
methods.description: Checks if a session key is a slash routing key.

methods.name: shouldRequireOAuthDir
methods.description: Determines if OAuth directory is required based on config and environment.

methods.name: shouldSuppressOrphanTranscriptWarning
methods.description: Checks if orphan transcript warnings should be suppressed based on backend config.

methods.name: noteStateIntegrity
methods.description: Performs diagnostics and repairs on application state directories and files, with user prompts.

methods.name: noteWorkspaceBackupTip
methods.description: Suggests backing up the workspace in a git repository if not already versioned.
